ns2:section.sectionTitle: P-H Loss Reductn Conf in Rome
ns2:section.sectionText: The students will attend the First International Congress on Postharvest Loss Reduction held in Rome (Oct. 4-7, 2015). Prior to the trip, the students will be working with Ms. Megan Puzey to be trained to assist at the conference as well as develop their ideas to attend specific presentations to write a technical article on a couple of interviews they will do at the conference with the presenters. Post trip, the students will write and publish a technical article. The estimated total time students will devote to this independent study is 105 hrs, which is broken down as follows: Pre-trip training: 20-25 hours (4-5 hours/week in September) Trip: 40 hours (10 hrs/day during conference, travel time not included) Post-trip write up and publication: 40 hours (10 hrs/week for 4 weeks projected for final publication) Total credit hours: 2 credit hours Student Learning Objectives: Upon attending the conference, students will be able to? 1. Discuss global postharvest loss issues and food security. 2. Develop a ?Roadmap for PHL Reduction?, which will detail how to significantly reduce losses by 2050. Students will be part of process in which a roadmap is developed. 3. Communicate summarized information of a scientific presentation. 4. Write a technical article based on an interview with an expert.
